post_qualification_check.command:
env COGNI_RUN_SAFE_MIN_FREE_PCT=50 RUN_SAFE_PASSTHROUGH_STDIO=1 TMPDIR=/private/tmp /Users/sergey/Projects/Crystal/cogni-ml/scripts/run_safe.sh /usr/bin/ruby 120 512 -e 'require "json"
require "digest"
packet = JSON.parse(File.binread(ARGV.fetch(0)))
packet.fetch("source_lineage").fetch("qualification_file_sha256").each do |path, hash|
  raise "qualification source hash mismatch: #{path}" unless Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest == hash
end
freeze = packet.fetch("source_lineage").fetch("final_freeze")
raise "source freeze digest mismatch" unless Digest::SHA256.file(freeze.fetch("path")).hexdigest == freeze.fetch("sha256")
raise "source freeze entry count mismatch" unless File.readlines(freeze.fetch("path")).length == freeze.fetch("entries")
packet.fetch("helper_builds").each do |helper|
  raise "helper artifact hash mismatch" unless helper.fetch("exit") == 0 && Digest::SHA256.file(helper.fetch("artifact")).hexdigest == helper.fetch("sha256")
end
units = packet.fetch("unit_evidence")
totals = Hash.new(0)
units.fetch("runs").each do |run|
  found = File.binread(run.fetch("log")).scan(/(\d+) examples, (\d+) failures, (\d+) errors, (\d+) pending/).last
  raise "missing unit result" unless found
  numbers = found.map(&:to_i)
  raise "unit result differs" unless run.fetch("exit") == 0 && numbers == [run.fetch("examples"), 0, 0, 0]
  totals[run.fetch("mode")] += numbers.first
end
raise "unit totals differ" unless totals == {"DEBUG" => 382, "RELEASE" => 382}
roster = units.fetch("runs").flat_map { |run| run.fetch("spec_files") }.uniq
raise "unique affected roster differs" unless roster.size == 69
final = units.fetch("final_layout_focused")
final.fetch("runs").each do |run|
  found = File.binread(run.fetch("log")).scan(/(\d+) examples, (\d+) failures, (\d+) errors, (\d+) pending/).last
  raise "final focused differs" unless run.fetch("exit") == 0 && found && found.map(&:to_i) == [39, 0, 0, 0]
end
native = packet.fetch("native_evidence")
inventories = native.fetch("runs").map do |run|
  root = run.fetch("evidence_root")
  summary = JSON.parse(File.binread(File.join(root, "summary.json")))
  raise "native counts/helper differ" unless run.fetch("exit") == 0 && summary.fetch("success") && summary.fetch("counts") == run.fetch("observed_counts") && summary.fetch("process_status_counts") == run.fetch("process_status_counts") && summary.fetch("helper_sha256_expected") == run.fetch("helper_sha256")
  output = JSON.parse(File.binread(File.join(root, "generated", "helper-output.json")))
  raise "profile roster differs" unless output.fetch("profiles").map { |profile| profile.fetch("id") } == native.fetch("expected_profile_ids")
  pairs = output.fetch("profiles").map do |profile|
    record = JSON.parse(File.binread(File.join(root, "cases", "#{profile.fetch("id")}-attached.json")))
    [profile.fetch("id"), record.fetch("generated_part_inventory")]
  end
  pairs.to_h
end
raise "cross-mode inventories differ" unless inventories[0] == inventories[1] && inventories[0].size == 9 && inventories[0].values.map(&:size).inject(0, :+) == 146
native.fetch("raw_audits").each do |run|
  raise "audit log/index differs" unless run.fetch("exit") == 0 && File.binread(run.fetch("log")).include?("W224 evidence audit ROBUST: profiles=9; constructor refusals=2;")
end
native.fetch("negative_controls").each do |run|
  phases = File.readlines(run.fetch("log")).select { |line| line.start_with?("{") }.map { |line| JSON.parse(line) }
  raise "negative control differs" unless run.fetch("exit") == 0 && phases.length == 2 && phases[0].fetch("phase") == "coherent_CHECK_result_zero_seed" && phases[0].fetch("audit_exit") == 1 && phases[0].fetch("summary_success_unchanged") && phases[1].fetch("phase") == "exact_restored_positive_control" && phases[1].fetch("audit_exit") == 0 && phases[1].fetch("restored_sha256") == run.fetch("restored_stdout_sha256")
end
puts JSON.pretty_generate("result" => "packet_references_and_recorded_counts_checked", "broad_unit_examples" => totals, "final_focused_examples_per_mode" => 39, "cross_mode_profiles" => 9, "cross_mode_files" => 146)
' .landmark/evidence/aggregate-function-recursive-w224.json > /private/tmp/crystal-click-w224.QtRy7J/packet-index-check.log 2>&1
post_qualification_check.limit: Reference/count/source-hash consistency only; not a replacement for the separately executed raw audits or behavioral checks.

status: VERIFIED within the nine measured static recursive profiles

claim.statement: Existing Array/Tuple/Map-values/Nested/eligible Nullable(Tuple) child codecs and physical schedules compose exact Count and W223 Sum-family opaque states. Contextual admission and public routing replace root-only guards without a serializer per product.
claim.adversary_verdict: ROBUST within the finite nine-profile, quiescent Wide/LZ4/Default/plain-mrk2 scope. General recursive products, other aggregate states and remaining layouts are not qualified.

trust.F: Behavioral RED/green tests, independent literal RowBinary/lane oracles, pinned stock/native runs and coherent raw-CHECK negative controls; not a formal proof.
trust.G: Nine physical profiles, five parent rows and real marks [2,2,1] plus terminal zero; broad affected tests are not exhaustive physical product qualification.
trust.R: Root executed all compiler/native/audit jobs and independently inspected code, source pins, raw records, inventories and restored hashes. Luna static review is correlated evidence, not independent runtime replication.

boundaries.risk: CAUTION: recursive state admission, shared codecs/public routing and persistent part publication
boundaries.rollback: Revert the exact-path coherent local W224 feature commit; preserve unrelated changes. No push or remote history changes.
accepted: Static recursively composed Array, named/unnamed Tuple, Map values with eligible ordinary keys, Nested and eligible direct Nullable(Tuple) enclosing exact Count or W223 Sum-family leaves.
Aggregate-free LowCardinality(String) sibling in a named Tuple, in the measured dictionary/index profile.
Generic BinaryBulk readers/writers and WidePartTable typed batches/windows; owned offline .values; ordinary offline typed callbacks/windows with unit controls.
Exact function/argument identity, Count VarUInt and opaque canonical Sum accumulator bytes; aggregate arguments are budgeted descriptor metadata, not stored child values.
guard_only_or_not_claimed: AggregateFunction in Map keys (stock empty Memory CREATE succeeds; library still refuses the physical profile).
Aggregate-bearing LowCardinality/Variant/Dynamic/JSON envelopes, unsupported aggregate families/parameters/versions and all Cartesian products.
Compact, sparse/custom serialization, mutable live parts, complete production payload-hash authentication.
New native OfflineTable projection integration or whole stock-catalog discovery; W224 selected projection child controls are unit-level.
Aggregate execution/finalization, native MV/projection writing/semantics, memory/performance or <=10 percent read-gap closure.
Whole-repository test pass, constructor-cost bounds, repeated-visitor cost, peak RSS or broad legacy facade decomposition.

architecture.law: Compose existing child serde with wrapper-specific stream, row-domain, prefix/state and mark context. RowBinary recursion alone does not certify MergeTree bulk layout.
architecture.count_boundary: Shared tag 0x25 is not Count identity. Legacy specialized Count dispatch requires exact nominal metadata.
architecture.argument_boundary: AggregateFunction argument descriptors have zero stored value children. sum(UInt8) uses an eight-byte accumulator, not the scalar UInt8 codec.
architecture.limits: The constructor admission walk is not independently cost-budgeted and may repeat subtree traversals. Physical consumers budget declarations before admission; no performance or RSS claim.

source_reference.distinction: Shallow comparison source and runtime build are separate pins, not same-build or perpetual latest-master compatibility.

final_freeze.command: rg --files src scripts spec -g '*.cr' -g '*.rb' | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs shasum -a 256 > /private/tmp/crystal-click-w224.QtRy7J/source-freeze-final.sha256

source_lineage.distinction: The broad 382-example runs in each mode qualify the pre-extraction production layout. After diagnostic-only wording, formatting and an unchanged Frame file extraction/require move, the seven-file final focused 39-example roster passes per mode. Fresh final helpers qualify the final production layout. Auditor-only carrier/census fixes follow the successful DEBUG runner; the final separate auditor qualifies both untouched raw trees. Documentation follows runtime qualification.
